newsitem.title: USA: Emclaire Financial names David Cox CEO.
newsitem.headline: Emclaire Financial names David Cox CEO.

text.p: Emclaire Financial Corp said Thursday it named David Cox as president and chief executive officer to replace Ronald Ashbaugh, 61, who is retiring after 37 years with the company.
Cox, 46, will assume his new role on January 1.
He will head both Emclaire and its wholly owned unit, The Farmers National Bank of Emlenton.
Cox has been with the company 23 years -- most recently as senior vice president of Farmers National and vice president of Emclaire, the company said.
